title: Buddy Bolden at Johnson Park and his tunes
summary: He recalls Johnson Park as older than Lincoln Park, Bolden as a very loud trumpeter heard for a mile, and tunes like Funky Butt and Careless Love (c. 1910).

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Buddy Bolden and Buddy Petit: the trumpet legends

blocks.x: Oh, how about a... You see, you see, Johnson Park was older than Lincoln Park. Yeah. How many years older, you see? Oh, God. It was there all the time, you know, like... Oh, yeah. I was right there. I was right there with the build. I was small. Yeah. You remember when Johnson Park was made then? Huh? Do you remember when Johnson Park was made? Oh, yeah. When they had the baseball park, right? They built it for a baseball park, and then they had... Then they turned into a little dance hall and baseball. Oh, I see. So Johnson Park was made around when, would you say? I guess it was there before Lincoln Park. Oh, I see. And, and, is that the place where Buddy Bolin played or...? Buddy Bolin, Buddy Bolin played at Johnson Park, the Moist. In Johnson Park, I see. He didn't play much at Lincoln Park. Uh-huh. And, uh... Buddy Bolin and Roby showed, they used to buckle against one another. Buck against one another? They used to have a dance hall, a dance, and save a knife, one without playing the other one. Oh, yeah. I'd blow one another. How about that? Buddy Bolin spoke, he laid out the window and blew his horn, you could hear him a mile. Even a mile? Yeah. How did it sound just across the street on Short Street? How did the Buddy Bolin? It sounded like music, sounded like a horn. I tell you, because you had a mile. You had a mile, yeah. At that time, at that time, there was nothing around him. You don't know what many howling things. Get your head now, way uptown there. Yeah. And you could, over a mile, you could hear that horn blowing. A lot of people said he was a loud trumpet player. Oh, he was loud trumpet player. He was loud trumpet player. He was loud? He was loud. He was loud. He blowed his brains out. He blew something out of his head. Do you remember any of the numbers, Buddy Bolin used to play? I know they used to play the blues and all that. Yeah, Valentine music. Yeah. Do you remember what, any of the numbers, like blues? Any of the blues? I don't know the numbers. I know they played the blues. Do you remember a thing called Funky Butt? Yeah. Funky Butt. Yeah, I remember that. Do you think he played that? Yeah, he played everything, I think. Yeah. You know, that kind of blues. Yeah. Or Bucket Cutter Hole. Bucket Cutter Hole. Yeah, he played that. What else? What is it? Uh, Kallus Love.
Do you remember Kallus Love? Yeah. Kallus Love. When did that come out?
